             and caller.f_code.co_name == '<module>', 'ONLY_REVIEWED_LITERAL_TOP_LEVEL_IMPORT')
        key = name if fromlist else name.split('.')[0]
        need(key in loaded_modules, 'PRELOADED_IMPORT_ONLY')
        return loaded_modules[key]
    safe_builtins = dict(vars(builtins))
    for key in ('open','input','eval','exec','compile','breakpoint'):
        safe_builtins.pop(key, None)
    safe_builtins['__import__'] = approved_import
    out, err = BoundedText(), BoundedText()
    old_out, old_err = sys.stdout, sys.stderr
    error = None
    outcome = None
    invoked = False
    partial = None
    failed_case = None
    capture_issue = None
    started_utc, started = now().isoformat(), time.monotonic_ns()
    sys.addaudithook(audit)
    try:
        sys.stdout, sys.stderr = out, err
        sys.setprofile(profile)
        def load(data, pin, namespace):
            target = types.ModuleType(namespace)
            target.__file__ = pin['path']
            target.__dict__['__builtins__'] = safe_builtins
            sys.modules[namespace] = target  # dataclasses requires actual namespace membership.
            state['loader_compile'] = pin['path']
            code = compile(data, pin['path'], 'exec')
            state['loader_compile'] = None
            state['loader_exec'] = code
            try:
                exec(code, target.__dict__)
            finally:
                state['loader_exec'] = None
            return target
        module = load(module_raw, b['module_Source'], '_i9_module_scoped_' + b['module_Source']['sha256'])
        fixture = load(fixture_raw, b['fixture_Source'], '_i9_fixture_scoped_' + b['fixture_Source']['sha256'])
        count, planned = s['expected_planned_case_count'], s['planned_case_names']
        need(type(fixture.EXPECTED_CASE_COUNT) is int and fixture.EXPECTED_CASE_COUNT == count,
             'LITERAL_API_SCOPE_COUNT_JOIN')
        need(type(fixture.PLANNED_CASE_NAMES) in (tuple,list) and list(fixture.PLANNED_CASE_NAMES) == planned,
             'LITERAL_API_SCOPE_NAMES_JOIN')
        invoked = True
        outcome = fixture.run_memory_suite(module)
        need(type(outcome) is dict and outcome['synthetic_fixture'] is True and
             type(outcome['filesystem_calls']) is int and outcome['filesystem_calls'] == 0 and
             outcome['project_or_native_tests'] is False, 'MEMORY_OUTCOME_FLAGS')
        cases = outcome['cases']
        need(type(cases) is list and len(cases) == count and [q['name'] for q in cases] == planned,
             'COMPLETE_EXACT_CASES')
        need(all(type(q) is dict and type(q['name']) is str and type(q['passed']) is bool and
             q['passed'] is True and q['synthetic_fixture'] is True and
             type(q['memory_record_reader_calls']) is int and q['memory_record_reader_calls'] >= 0
             for q in cases), 'STRICT_CASE_FLAGS')
        need(type(outcome['checks_passed']) is int and outcome['checks_passed'] == count and
             type(outcome['checks_failed']) is int and outcome['checks_failed'] == 0, 'STRICT_CASE_COUNTS')
        need(all(v == 1 for v in compile_counts.values()) and all(v == 1 for v in exec_counts.values()),
             'EXACT_ONE_COMPILE_AND_EXEC_PER_NEW_TARGET')
        need(not blocked and all(v > 0 for v in calls.values()) and
             all(function_counts.get(name, 0) > 0 for name in b['required_positive_module_function_names']),
             'REQUIRED_NEW_TARGET_PROFILE')
        need(not out.overcap and not err.overcap and time.monotonic_ns()-started <= 60000000000,
             'MEMORY_RUN_CAPS')
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = dict(type=type(exc).__name__, message=str(exc)[:8192])
        try:
            tb = exc.__traceback__
            while tb is not None:
                frame = tb.tb_frame
                if frame.f_code.co_filename == fixture_path and frame.f_code.co_name == 'run_memory_suite':
                    local_cases, local_case = frame.f_locals.get('cases'), frame.f_locals.get('case')
                    if type(local_cases) is list:
                        partial = decode(json.dumps(local_cases, allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8'))
                    if type(local_case) is str:
                        failed_case = local_case[:4096]
                tb = tb.tb_next
        except BaseException as capture_error:
            capture_issue = type(capture_error).__name__ + ':' + str(capture_error)[:4096]
    finally:
        sys.setprofile(None)
        state['active'] = False
        sys.stdout, sys.stderr = old_out, old_err
    elapsed = time.monotonic_ns()-started
    def stream(item):
        data = bytes(item.data)
        return dict(bytes=len(data), sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                    UTF8_text=data.decode('utf-8','strict'), overcap=item.overcap)
    completed = len(outcome['cases']) if type(outcome) is dict and type(outcome.get('cases')) is list else (
        len(partial) if type(partial) is list else None)
    record = dict(schema_version=1, record_type='Root_actual_once_I9_synthetic_memory_suite_saved_result',
        author='/root', created_utc=now().isoformat(), started_utc=started_utc, scope=scope_pin,
        attempt_number=attempt, consumption_marker=marker, module_Source=b['module_Source'],
        fixture_Source=b['fixture_Source'], API=b['API'], actual_Source_adoption=b['Source_adoption'],
        tests_executed=invoked, I9_memory_test_runs=1 if invoked else 0, fixture_entry_invoked=invoked,
        synthetic_memory_only=True, expected_planned_case_count=s['expected_planned_case_count'],
        planned_case_names=s['planned_case_names'], actual_test_case_count=completed,
        partial_completed_cases_at_failure=partial, failed_or_last_case_at_failure=failed_case,
        partial_capture_issue=capture_issue, case_count_boundary='Completed saved outcomes only; interrupted case separate; unknown null.',
        all_cases_passed=error is None, error=error, outcome=outcome, elapsed_integer_nanoseconds=elapsed,
        profile_call_counts=calls, new_module_function_call_counts=function_counts,
        target_compile_counts=compile_counts, target_exec_counts=exec_counts,
        ast_parse_internal_compile_events=state['AST_parse_compile_events'], audit_event_counts=events,
        blocked_forbidden_event_names=blocked,
        audit_evidence_boundary='Observed CPython audit events plus reviewed Source; not exhaustive stat/native or security isolation proof.',
        stdout=stream(out), stderr=stream(err), original_I0_I1_I2_I3_I4_I5_I6_I7_I8_import_call_or_test=False,
        original_project_native_Parser_runtime_scientific_execution=False, actual_canonical_IO=False,
        owner_lease_qualified=False, producer_qualified=False, caller_qualified=False,
        actual_native_human_physical_provenance_qualified=False, actual_entry_authorized=False,
        operational_authority=False, scientific_authority=False)
    print(json.dumps(save(P/n['child_result'], record), sort_keys=True))
    if error is not None:
        raise SystemExit(1)
